problem.title: Construct a Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversals
problem.problemStatement: Given the preorder traversal and inorder traversal of a binary tree containing unique values, reconstruct the original binary tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the preorder traversal. • The third line contains the inorder traversal.
problem.output: • Print the reconstructed tree in the required traversal format.
